newsitem.title: USA: Amrep reaches agreement with IRS on tax.
newsitem.headline: Amrep reaches agreement with IRS on tax.

text.p: Amrep Corp said Thursday it has reached an agreement with the Internal Revenue Service, resolving all outstanding issues resulting from the agency's audit covering the years 1984 to 1989.
Amrep said it has paid an assessment of about $200,000 for federal taxes, including interest, and anticipates no significant further payments for either state or federal taxes for those year.
Amrep said that, as previously announced, the IRS is also in the process of reviewing the company's tax returns for the years 1990 through 1994.
In due course, it said the IRS is also expected to review its 1995 tax return.

The company said that, while it cannot be totally certain of the results of these audits, it currently estimates that total additional amount that will be due for federal and state taxes, when the reviews are completed for the year 1990-1995 will be about $8.5 million plus interest estimated to be about $3.5 million as of January 31, 1997.
The company said it previously provided reserves to cover the possible additional taxes and estimatated interest and does not expect that they will impact reported earnings.
